notes.title: How to solve the problem to purchase items in the Shop
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team.

Thank you for playing our Early Access version.

If you have disabled the Steam overlay setting, 
you will not be able to purchase any items in the Shop.

If you are unable to purchase items in the shop, 
please change the Steam overlay setting to effective by referring to the following instructions.

[h2][u][b]①Change the overlay settings for the entire Steam[/b][/u][/h2]

・Launch the Steam client application.

・Select "Steam" -> "Settings" from the top menu bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463791/8f56590907214f553ecb98c2f5076cf9e6d663dc.png[/img]

・In the "Settings" menu, select "In-Game".

・Check the "Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game" checkbox.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463791/44c18d891ea1ac381680bfb0e167e7996daf7878.png[/img]

・Press "OK" at the bottom of the menu to save the settings.

[h2][u][b]②Change overlay settings for each game[/b][/u][/h2]

・Launch the Steam client application.

・Select the "Library" tab in the main window.

・Right-click on the game from the list on the left and select "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463791/02f00f3032827eb828ffcc4e25147b27be6136ba.png[/img]

・Select the "General" tab and check the "Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game" checkbox.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463791/3969d7c237769510025f87d4882b1435ea0b0200.png[/img]


We have released this title as an early access version in order to build it up together with you, with your support, opinions and messages.
We hope you will continue to support us in our ongoing development.
Thank you very much for your support.

notes.title: Opened early access version
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing the early access version of KUUKIYOMI: Consider It! ONLINE.

We'll be adding and improving features as we receive feedback and watch playthroughs. Keep your eyes peeled!

Planned features:
- Upgraded avatar functions
- Room creation
- Team battles
- Consideration VS Inconsideration
...and more!

You'll be seeing more avatars being added in the days ahead, including avatars that can be purchased using KY coins, so collect as many coins as you can! Send us all your feedback and requests via email or social media. We'd love to hear from you!

Thank you very much for your support! We really appreciate it!

KUUKIYOMI: Consider It! ONLINE Management Team
